sonnet.problem: The question says 'Because He has redeemed them', which gives away the right answer to the later card 10 ('The LORD has redeemed Jacob'). Card 10 then re-asks the same 'redeemed' fact, and its wrong answers make the right one stand out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card puts a first-person line ('I baked bread on half of it, so should I bow down to a block of wood?') in Papa Dorin's narration with no quotation marks and no one named as the speaker. It reads as Papa Dorin saying 'I', not as the imagined idol maker in verse 19.
sonnet.rule: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.
